remarks: Incredible 1 bed 1.5 baths condo in SoNo! Beautiful condition with lots of upgrades! New breakfast bar, counter tops and stainless steel kitchen sink. New dishwasher in 2023, New HVAC in 2024, New stove/oven 2025, new floor in half bath 2026, and all vents and ducks cleaned in 2025 and tons of storage, floor to ceiling built- in's in living room allowing more living space for less furniture and 3 more closet. Convenient walk to museums, restaurants, train, post office and shopping at the new SoNo Collection Mall! Convenient to major highways and public transportation, enjoy 2 beaches, golf course and all the amenities of Norwalk!  Please remove shoes to prevent bringing snow and salt in.
